correctness.rationale: PASS. At initial parallel firing the outdegree-k source distributes exactly one grain per disjoint directed cycle, never receives grains and never fires again. Induction gives exactly one grain at cycle index (t-1) mod n_i at every t>=1. Pairwise gcd(n_i,n_j)=g by coprime quotients; the generalized Chinese remainder theorem makes a tuple reachable iff all indices have common residue modulo g. Thus the exact complex is an isolated initial broadcaster plus g mutually vertex-disjoint joins D_{m1}*...*D_{mk}; their integral homotopy is wedges of prod(m_i-1) spheres of degree k-1 and reduced H0 rank g, free all higher groups. Every finite directed positive-outdegree configuration with k conserved grains fires at most k vertices at once, giving upper dimension k-1; the construction attains it for all k>=2. Independently simulated complete support periods for six parameter tuples and matched every CRT support. Top integral assertion relies on mathematical join decomposition rather than tested field ranks.
